title: PIXEL RELOAD AND FORGED GUNS
why: Idea I1 of the graphics list. A reload and a forged gun flipped the gun on a pixel body to the smooth vector gun. Now the pixel gun tips down by the vector timings, the far hand reaches the magazine well in four steps, the spent magazine falls, and a forged gun keeps its pixel gold with the shine and element glow drawn over it (shed on the first quality rung). Cosmetic only.
now: Reloads and forged guns stay in the pixel style.
